_about: Visual blueprints for recast templates: one string per separate image, in reveal order. The art director must follow them exactly (positions, poses, expressions) and dress the people for the meme's workplace. Labels never go in the image; the app lists them below. Never name the original meme or its people in prompts.
Distracted Boyfriend: Exactly three people on a city street, eye level. Left foreground, slightly out of focus: a confident woman in a bright red dress walking away from the camera to the left, glancing back. Center: a young man walking hand in hand with his girlfriend, but turning his head and upper body back over his shoulder to stare at the woman in red, lips pursed in an appreciative whistle, eyebrows raised. Right: his girlfriend holding his hand, mouth open, glaring at him in outraged disbelief.
Two Buttons: Close-up of a control panel with two big round red buttons side by side, a gloved hand hovering between them.
The same person, sweating heavily, wiping their brow with a cloth, eyes darting, face full of panic, as if the choice is impossible.
Drake: Upper body of a man in a bright orange puffer jacket against a plain yellow background, turning his face away with a grimace of disgust, one hand raised palm-out to reject something off to the side.
The same man and background, now smiling with satisfied approval, pointing a finger to the side at something he likes.
Crying Cat Interview: A cheerful interviewer with a microphone leans toward a visibly exhausted worker in front of the workplace, smiling and enthusiastic.
Close-up of the worker's face: watery, trembling eyes on the verge of tears, forced polite smile, while the interviewer's microphone is still held out.
Roll Safe: One continuous scene, medium shot, waist up. Exactly one person standing on the left, looking straight at the camera with a knowing, smug grin, tapping his temple with one finger, as if he just had the cleverest idea. Behind him, to the right, the same scene continues into the background and clearly shows the absurd result of his idea (the place or situation the caption is about), large enough to recognize at a glance.
This Is Fine: A cartoon character sits calmly at a small table holding a coffee mug, a relaxed smile on his face, while the room around him is on fire: flames on the walls, smoke along the ceiling. He is not bothered at all.
Grave Selfie: A cemetery on a sunny day. In the foreground, a person in business clothes takes a cheerful selfie, grinning widely with a thumbs up, while a fresh grave with flowers and a plain headstone sits right behind them.
Moe Throws Barney Out: A bar. A stern bartender throws a scruffy customer out through the front door by the collar and the back of the belt; the customer flies through the air.
The same bar a moment later: the same scruffy customer is already back on his stool at the counter, smiling, while the bartender stares at him in disbelief.
Baboon and Sleeping Lion: Savanna at dusk. A lion sleeps peacefully on a rock in the foreground, eyes closed. Behind it, a sneaky baboon creeps up on tiptoe, holding a big stick raised over its head, about to strike, grinning mischievously.
Fish Bait: Underwater scene. A fishing hook hangs from a line with a bait on it. A fish swims straight at it with its mouth wide open and eager eyes, while bones of earlier fish lie on the sand below.
Soldier Shields the Wrong Side: Wide, simple scene on a beige background. Left: a soldier kneels with arms spread wide, heroically shielding the empty left side. Right: a man sleeps peacefully on a bed, while knives, grenades and missiles fly at him from the upper right, the side nobody guards.
The Plan: An office presenter in a suit stands proudly at a whiteboard on an easel, pointing at step one of a plan drawn as simple icons.
Same presenter, still confident, pointing at the second step.
Same presenter, pointing at the third step, smiling.
Same presenter staring at the fourth step on the board, smile frozen, eyes wide in sudden horror as he realizes the plan backfires.
Expanding Brain: A person sits with eyes closed; a small, dim brain floats beside their head on a dark background.
Same person, the brain is bigger and glows softly.
Same person, the brain is large and shines brightly, sparks around it.
Same person radiating cosmic light, the brain is huge and glowing like a galaxy, the background full of stars.
Bike Fall: A cyclist rides along, then jams a stick into the spokes of their own front wheel with a determined face.
The cyclist flies over the handlebars and crashes to the ground.
The cyclist lies on the ground, angrily pointing at something else and blaming it, refusing to look at the stick.
Is This a Pigeon: Retro cartoon style. A man with glasses stands confidently, one hand raised, gesturing toward a butterfly fluttering beside him, completely misidentifying it with total certainty.
Monkey Looks Away: A plush monkey puppet faces forward with wide eyes, caught in an awkward moment.
The same puppet slowly turns its eyes and head to the side, looking away, nervously avoiding eye contact.
Clown Makeup: A person at a mirror applies the first white base of clown makeup, still looking hopeful.
Same person, more makeup: painted smile and colored eyes.
Same person with a red clown nose and a colorful wig.
Same person in full clown makeup, wig, nose and frilly collar, staring at the viewer with a resigned expression.
Then vs Now: Two dogs side by side. Left: a huge muscular, proud dog standing tall, chest out. Right: a small, round, anxious dog with sad eyes, slumping.
Trade Offer: A smug man in a suit faces the viewer across a desk, both hands raised in a framing gesture, offering a deal with a sly smile.
Panik Kalm Panik: A simple, flat-shaded bald character staring in panic, sweating.
The same character relaxed and calm, eyes half closed, smiling.
The same character in even greater panic than before, eyes huge.
Always Has Been: Outer space. An astronaut floats looking at Earth, hand raised in shock as if realizing something; behind him a second astronaut silently points a pistol at his back.
Pointing at Each Other: Two identical people in identical clothes stand facing each other, each pointing an accusing finger at the other, both outraged.
Draw 25: A person holds up a single card, considering it.
The same person now holds a huge, overflowing hand of cards, defiant, having chosen to draw rather than do what the card says.
Yelling at the Cat: Left half: an upset woman yells and points across a table, a friend holding her back.
Right half: a white cat sits at a dinner table in front of a plate of salad, looking unbothered and confused, as if it said something sensible.
Pained Smile: Close-up of an older man with gray hair smiling politely at the camera, holding a mug, while his eyes show deep, hidden pain.
Two Sides of the Bus: Inside a bus, two passengers sit by opposite windows. Left: one smiles happily at a sunny landscape outside. Right: the other stares blankly at a dark rock wall right outside their window, a single tear on their cheek.
Swerve to the Exit: A highway seen from behind a car. Signs point straight ahead and to an exit on the right. The car swerves hard toward the exit at the last moment, tires smoking.
Unmasking: A group of young detectives stands around a captured, masked villain tied to a chair; one of them reaches out and pulls off the mask, revealing the culprit underneath, everyone gasping.
Waiting Skeleton: A skeleton sits on a park bench in a long-abandoned place, cobwebs between the bones and the bench, overgrown grass around, still waiting patiently.
Slaps Roof: A car salesman grins and slaps the roof of a car with one hand, proudly showing it off to the viewer, which is packed to the brim.
Same Picture: An office worker holds up two nearly identical pictures side by side, one in each hand.
Close-up of a different office worker with glasses, looking at them with a blank, deadpan expression.
Hard Pills: A hand holds a large prescription pill bottle labeled only by color, a single large pill resting in the open palm beside it.
Window Envy: Seen from inside a gloomy room: a sad character with droopy eyes looks out of a window at others outside having fun in the sunshine, chin on his hand.
Shocked Face: A small cartoon creature does something obviously reckless.
The same creature with its mouth wide open and eyes huge in total shock at the completely predictable result.
Domino Effect: A row of dominoes on a table: a tiny domino at the front is about to tip, and the dominoes grow in size, ending in a gigantic domino towering over everything at the end.
Iceberg: Cross-section of an iceberg in calm water: a small tip above the waterline, and a huge, dark, layered mass hidden underwater below it.
Ant Carries the Elephant: Exactly two animals on a dirt path, side view. A tiny ant, legs trembling, sweating and straining, carries an enormous elephant balanced on its back. The elephant sits upright on the ant, relaxed and proud, nose in the air, holding up one tiny, weightless object (a single leaf) in its trunk as if it were the heaviest load in the world.
Fancy Version: A cartoon bear in plain clothes, looking ordinary.
The same bear in a tuxedo, sipping from a fancy glass, looking smug and refined.
